member.summary: Minify an svg document (or an xml fragment with several root elements) according to the options. If the first svg element has a view box with a positive size, its width and height attributes are always removed (also when is false), and x / y attributes that are zero are removed. Some optimizations (clip-rule / fill-rule removal, and ) render the document with System.Drawing (Windows only, they are skipped silently if rendering fails). The DOCTYPE is always removed. The optimization steps are repeated until the document doesn't change any more (at most 8 passes), so minifying the output again doesn't change it (svg-cov-49). A step is only repeated if a step that can enable further optimizations of it changed the document after its last run (see ).

member.name: F:SysWeaver.Minifier.SvgMinifier.Steps
member.summary: All optimization steps, in execution order, with the steps that can enable further optimizations of each step (the dependency graph). The order is chosen so that most dependencies point backwards (one pass is usually enough): - Element removal (NonSvg, Title, Metadata, Hidden, Background, Graphs) and attribute removal (NonSvg, Fill, Rules, Ids, UseSize, Version) can make ids unused (Ids, RenameIds), g elements attribute-less or empty (Graphs), namespace declarations unused (NamespaceCleanup), and text nodes neighbours (TextNodes). - Ids can remove the last attribute of a g element (Graphs), Graphs can remove an empty g element with an id or a reference (Ids, RenameIds). These two are the only dependency cycle that points forward (rare, handled by a second pass). - RenameIds depends on everything that changes the use counts of ids (Ids and all removals above), renaming an already renamed document is a no-op. - The rendering based Rules (clip-rule / fill-rule / attribute removal) depends on steps that change the geometry or the painting (Decimals, Transform rounding, Fill, Background), so it runs after them. - Background (the first rect) depends on element removals before it and on the rounding (Decimals). - UseSize ("100%") depends on TrailingZeros ("100.0%"). - The value formatting steps (AttributeSpaces, Colors, TrailingZeros, LeadingZeros, ShortenPath, Transform) are idempotent, run after the rounding (Decimals) in an order where each one keeps the output of the previous ones, and are not affected by removals: they run once. - Comments, Namespaces, NonSvg, Title, Metadata, Decimals, Fill and Version don't depend on any other step: they run once.

member.name: M:SysWeaver.Minifier.SvgMinifier.SetMaxDecimals(System.String,System.Int32,System.Boolean)
member.summary: Round all numbers in the value that have a decimal point or an exponent to at most maxDecimals decimals (banker's rounding). Numbers are tokenized like svg numbers: digits, an optional '.' with digits and an optional exponent ("e-5"), a '.' after a number's decimals starts a new number ("1.5.5" is 1.5 and .5); the sign is left as is, unless the number is rounded to zero ("-0.001" => "0"). Numbers with a decimal point are written without leading / trailing zeros ("0.50" => ".5", "1.0" => "1"), numbers with an exponent are only changed if rounding changes their value, integers are never changed. A space is inserted between two numbers if the second would otherwise merge with the first ("1.5.5" with 0 decimals => "2 0"). If isPath is true, the value is path data: the large-arc-flag and sweep-flag of arcs are single chars ("a5 5 0 0110 10") and are kept as is.

member.summary: Remove id attributes that are not referenced (by href="#id", or url(#id) in an attribute or a style element), and attributes referencing a missing id (except fill and stroke). In a style attribute only the css declarations referencing a missing id are removed (the attribute is removed if nothing is left). Ids that may be used by text the minifier can't rewrite (style elements, ex: "#id" selectors, script elements, "on..." event attributes, begin / end and aria id reference attributes) are never removed (a conservative word match: any word "a" in a script keeps an id "a").

member.name: F:SysWeaver.Minifier.SvgMinifierParams.RenameIds
member.summary: Rename all ids to short names and update the references (href="#id", url(#id) in attributes and style elements). The ids are ordered by their number of uses (the id attribute + references, ties: first occurrence first), the most used id gets "a", the next "b" .. "z", then two char names ("aa", "ba" ..) and so on. The generated names never collide: ids that may be used by text that can't be rewritten (see ) and references to ids that are not defined in the document keep their name, and no other id is renamed to that name (or to any word of such a text). Note: ids that are only referenced from outside the document (ex: "sprite.svg#icon" or css of a html page) are renamed too.
